brief.description: What the video must say, for whom, and how long — the brief an agent writes the composition from.

state.description: draft until rendered; rendering while the renderer works; ready with a file; failed with the reason in render.error. Set by the gateway, not the caller.

composition.description: The video as one HTML composition: a root element with data-composition-id, data-width/data-height/data-duration, timed scenes with data-start/data-duration and class="clip", animated with CSS keyframes or the Web Animations API. Self-contained: no external URLs, scripts, iframes or network calls. Saved with videos.save, which checks it.

render.description: The last render, written by the gateway: status, format, bytes, seconds, error, started_at, finished_at.

sources.description: Object ids the video was made from — a doc, dashboard, design, release.
